_help: brain can be 'ollama' (free, runs on your PC), 'online' (Groq or Gemini, free tiers, needs a key), 'claude' (paid, smarter, needs a key) or 'demo' (no AI, just to test the wiring).
_kb_help: Folder where your lucent-kb repository is cloned. Relative paths are from this folder.
_online_help: For brain 'online'. Groq: url https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, model llama-3.3-70b-versatile. Gemini: url https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai, model gemini-2.5-flash. Key in env ONLINE_AI_KEY.
_claude_key_help: Do NOT paste the key here. Set it as a Windows environment variable called ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
_whatsapp_provider_help: 'whatsmcp' = the WhatsMCP service you already use (default). 'meta' = Meta's official Cloud API directly.

whatsmcp._help: API key goes in the environment variable WAMCP_KEY. account_id is shown in your WhatsMCP dashboard (or run: python run.py whatsmcp-accounts).

whatsapp._help: allowed_numbers: ONLY these numbers can command the team, e.g. ["919812345678"]. Leave the rest empty unless you use provider 'meta'. Meta token goes in WHATSAPP_TOKEN.
whatsapp._groups_help: allowed_groups: part of the names of groups the team may read and reply in, e.g. ["Production"]. In those groups it only answers allowed numbers (and listed staff for done/update) whose message starts with group_trigger.

_staff_help: Staff messages: 'approve' = nothing is sent to staff until you reply 'send 3' / 'send all'. 'auto' = task messages go out straight away. Staff are listed in contacts.local.json.
_middleman_help: For 'python run.py middleman': a free filter that watches WhatsApp and only calls the CEO AI (Grok via xAI) when a message needs it. brain 'online' + online_url https://api.x.ai/v1 = Grok; key in env XAI_API_KEY. Check console.x.ai for the cheapest current Grok model name. poll_seconds below 300 needs the WhatsMCP Pro plan (or use receive: webhook on Starter).
_routes_help: Which bot answers which group or person (middleman). chat = part of a group name, or a phone number (91...). bot = ceo, cos, cfo, coo, qa, eng, scm, fd, ra, bd, dom, hr, team (whole team, costs more) or ignore. brain (optional) = grok, claude or default. everyone = true lets anyone in that group talk to the bot. First match wins; anything not listed goes to the CEO.
_email_help: For the middleman: reads new emails (read only) and passes them to Grok; Grok's reply comes to you on WhatsApp. Gmail/Google Workspace: create an App password, then setx EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD "...". Put your address in user. skip_senders / always_read take parts of email addresses. Nothing is ever sent by email.
